thread:
jessica: Quick sync — Acme pilot kickoff scheduled for Mon. Need to lock success gates, confirm SE roster/week-of office hours, and finalize deliverables. Customer expects a 4-week run. Can SEs cover Wed/Thu office hours each week? Also need confirmation on SSO and that no PHI will be sent.

mike: I can cover Wed mornings (PST) and Thu afternoons. I’ll be the primary SE. Need the top 3 production use cases and a few eval prompts to size tuning work.

nora: Drafting success gates now. Proposing: 1) functional correctness on key prompts (see examples), 2) throughput/latency within SLA, 3) <=5% regression vs baseline on quality evals, 4) runbook for handoff.

mike: For latency targets, what are we aiming for? 95p token latency? Also what's expected concurrency / RPS?

jessica: Customer goal is sub-300ms 95p for per-inference (single-turn, ~256 tokens). They expect burst to 30 concurrent sessions. Dataset: ~20k docs, mostly English, no PHI.

samir: Security check — confirm data residency (region), S3 access pattern, and whether they need private deployment or VPC peering. I’ll need the security questionnaire (IAC) completed before SSO work.

sec-bot: Automated note: please attach the latest security-questionnaire-v2 and indicate required controls (KMS, VPC, audit logs). Link: https://internal/docs/sec-templates

mike: Ok — propose a lightweight eval matrix: (a) intent/extraction exact-match on 1k held prompts, (b) semantic similarity >= 0.78 on retrieval-augmented tests, (c) latency 95p <300ms on steady load tests. We can run a mini-eval in Week 1 to baseline.

nora: Milestones (proposed):
```
Week 0 (kickoff): dataset + access, success gates agreed
Week 1: ingest+index, baseline mini-evals, initial prompt set v0
Week 2: tuning (quant/ batching), latency perf tests, SE office hours 2x
Week 3: regression checks, retention tests, acceptance criteria review
Week 4: acceptance demo, handoff docs + runbook, pricing recap
```

jessica: Owners: dataset & infra — customer + eng-oncall; SE tuning & evals — mike; success metrics & acceptance — nora; security sign-off — samir. I’ll own overall PM coordination.

mike: SE coverage confirmed: I’ll block Wed 9–11am PST and Thu 1–3pm PST weekly. I can do extra async troubleshooting if needed. Oncall contact: eng-oncall (pager).

samir: I need the completed questionnaire and the asset classification by Thurs EOD to unblock VPC/peering requests.

nora: Can we get final sign-off on gates and schedule by EOD Friday? I’ll bake the milestones into the pilot playbook once confirmed.

jessica: Sounds good — I’ll send calendar invites and the prompt list draft today. Please react with :thumbsup: if you’re aligned or call out any blockers.

mike: :thumbsup: aligned.

samir: :+1: will send security checklist items shortly.

nora: :thumbsup: adding to playbook now.

jessica: Thanks team — follow-up touchpoint Fri 4pm PT after internal review.
